lines.text: There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them,
the princes of Judah in their company,
the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.
Summon Your power, O God;
show Your strength, O God,
which You have exerted on our behalf.
Because of Your temple at Jerusalem
kings will bring You gifts.
Rebuke the beast in the reeds,
the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations,
until it submits, bringing bars of silver.
Scatter the nations who delight in war.
Envoys will arrive from Egypt;
Cush will stretch out her hands to God.
Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth;
sing praises to the Lord—
Selah
to Him who rides upon the highest heavens of old;
behold, His mighty voice resounds.
Ascribe the power to God,
whose majesty is over Israel,
whose strength is in the skies.
O God, You are awesome in Your sanctuary;
the God of Israel Himself
gives strength and power to His people.
Blessed be God!

pictures.scene: Diego Velázquez, Prince Baltasar Carlos on Horseback — the boy prince riding out in command on the rearing horse, there is Benjamin the youngest ruling them, the princes of Judah in their company
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_baltasar_carlos_on_horseback

pictures.scene: Anthony van Dyck, Lord John Stuart and His Brother Lord Bernard Stuart — the two young princes standing together in silver and gold, the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali, summon Your power O God
pictures.name: pd_van_dyck_stuart_brothers

pictures.scene: Rosa Bonheur, The Horse Fair — the great horses rearing and plunging against the men who hold them, show Your strength O God, which You have exerted on our behalf
pictures.name: pd_bonheur_the_horse_fair

pictures.scene: Edward Poynter, The Visit of the Queen of Sheba to King Solomon — the queen come up the steps of the lion throne with her train of gifts behind her, because of Your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring You gifts
pictures.name: pd_poynter_queen_of_sheba

pictures.scene: Paulus Potter, De stier — the bull standing huge in the meadow with the herdsman and the cattle beside him, rebuke the beast in the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations
pictures.name: pd_potter_de_stier

pictures.scene: Titian, The Tribute Money — the coin held up to Christ and His quiet answer to it, until it submits bringing bars of silver, scatter the nations who delight in war
pictures.name: pd_titian_the_tribute_money

pictures.scene: David Roberts, Grand Entrance to the Temple of Luxor — the great Egyptian gateway with its colossi and the people small before it, envoys will arrive from Egypt, Cush will stretch out her hands to God
pictures.name: pd_roberts_temple_of_luxor

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Ghent Altarpiece, Singing Angels — the choir crowded over the one book with their mouths open in the song, sing to God O kingdoms of the earth, sing praises to the Lord
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_singing_angels

pictures.scene: Jacob van Ruisdael, View of Haarlem with Bleaching Grounds — the towering clouds filling the sky over the small town far below, Selah, to Him who rides upon the highest heavens of old
pictures.name: pd_ruisdael_view_of_haarlem

pictures.scene: Johan Christian Dahl, The Eruption of Vesuvius — the fire and the smoke column going up off the mountain into the night, behold His mighty voice resounds, ascribe the power to God
pictures.name: pd_dahl_eruption_of_vesuvius

pictures.scene: Gustav Bauernfeind, Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives at Sunrise — the whole city lit along the temple wall with the pilgrims coming up the road, whose majesty is over Israel, whose strength is in the skies
pictures.name: pd_bauernfeind_jerusalem_from_the_mount_of_olives

pictures.scene: Emanuel de Witte, Interior of a Church — the vaults going up out of sight over the two small figures on the floor, O God You are awesome in Your sanctuary, the God of Israel Himself
pictures.name: pd_de_witte_interior_of_a_church

pictures.scene: Jean-François Millet, The Angelus — the two in the field stopped at their work with heads bowed in the evening light, gives strength and power to His people, blessed be God
pictures.name: pd_millet_the_angelus
